body:
Stacked on #7273.

## Summary
- With headphone output the far end never reaches the microphone, so every direct-mic span is the session owner. Those spans previously became exemplars only after a manual speaker assignment, which users rarely make for themselves.
- `listener-core`: the source actor computes headphone state once per capture start, uses it for AEC, and emits a new `SessionDataEvent::MicIsolated`. The `NO_AEC` override does not imply isolation.
- `plugins/transcription`: keeps a sticky per-session `mic_isolated` flag (one shared-speaker stretch pins it to false) and hands it to a `MicIsolationCache` on stop so extraction, which runs after the session ends, can read it. `extract_voiceprint_candidates` then promotes direct-mic candidates to owner exemplars with the new `isolated_mic_capture` confirmation source (label confidence 0.9). The manual promotion path now shares the same helper.
- `db-app`: rebuilds `voiceprint_exemplars` to widen the `confirmation_source` CHECK. The table is `sync_scope = 'local_only'` with no triggers or foreign keys; columns are unchanged, so older builds keep inserting and reading rows.
- Regenerated `bindings.gen.ts` gains the `mic_isolated` data event; no desktop TS changes were needed.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo test -p listener-core -p db-app -p tauri-plugin-transcription` (new: capture-settings resolver, sticky isolation merge, direct-mic speaker dedupe, new source accepted, rebuild keeps rows and indexes)
- [x] `cargo clippy --locked -p listener-core -p db-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` (the plugin has pre-existing clippy failures unrelated to this change)
- [x] `pnpm -F desktop typecheck`
- [ ] Record with headphones, name nobody, then check `voiceprint_exemplars` has `isolated_mic_capture` rows for the owner
- [ ] Unplug headphones mid-recording and confirm no owner exemplars are created

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Auto-labeling the session owner from mic isolation could mis-attribute voiceprints if headphone detection or the sticky isolation flag is wrong; the migration rebuilds a local table but copies existing rows.
> 
> **Overview**
> Headphone output is treated as **mic-isolated** capture: the direct-mic channel is assumed to carry only the local user, so owner voiceprints can be confirmed without a manual self-assignment.
> 
> **Capture (`listener-core`)** refactors AEC/headphone detection into `CaptureSettings` and emits a new **`mic_isolated`** data event
title: Confirm the owner's voiceprint from headphone-isolated recordings
